summary: Liberty Star Uranium & Metals Corp. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 21, 2026 with Monroe Street Capital Partners LP, and issuance effective September 24, 2026 of a convertible promissory note with a $95,700 principal amount reflecting a 10% original issue discount, bearing 8% interest and maturing one year from the agreement date. Proceeds fund general operations; principal and accrued interest convert into common stock. The filing is a routine financing under Items 1.01/2.03, not a special situation. Watch dilution and conversion pricing mechanics.
